# Release Requirements Checklist: Private Net Worth PWA

**Purpose**: Review whether privacy, financial correctness, PWA, accessibility, compatibility, and
release requirements are complete and testable before task generation.

**Created**: 2026-09-03

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` workflow.

**Review Ownership**: `[x]` means a reviewer found the written requirement sufficient; it does not
mean implementation is complete.

## Privacy and Cryptography Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Is every browser persistence surface assigned explicit allowed and forbidden content?
      [Completeness, Browser Contract]
- [x] CHK002 Are encryption, authentication, KDF, salt, IV, key-lifetime, and metadata requirements
      unambiguous? [Clarity, Research R4]
- [x] CHK003 Are wrong-passphrase, tamper, interrupted-write, migration, and failed-import outcomes
      non-destructive? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is the zero-network privacy promise defined across requests, URLs, logs, caches,
      sockets, beacons, and worker messages? [Completeness, FR-031]
- [x] CHK005 Is the portable backup format bounded, versioned, non-identifying, and
      validate-before-overwrite? [Consistency, FR-021-FR-024]

## Financial Requirements

- [x] CHK006 Are money precision, rounding, amount/rate/year bounds, and locale parsing rules
      explicit? [Clarity, Data Model]
- [x] CHK007 Are zero-rate, non-amortizing, overpayment, payoff, term, future-date, and
      manual-override projection rules covered? [Coverage, FR-011-FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 Are missing asset years, incomplete totals, actual/projected status, yearly change, and
      undefined CAGR semantics stated? [Consistency, FR-014-FR-018]
- [x] CHK009 Is every built-in asset/liability type and custom-field requirement enumerated?
      [Completeness, FR-008-FR-009]

## Accessibility and PWA Requirements

- [x] CHK010 Do requirements cover keyboard, focus, dialog, errors, touch, contrast, zoom/reflow,
      reduced motion, safe areas, and screen readers? [Completeness, FR-032-FR-034]
- [x] CHK011 Must every chart expose exactly equivalent captioned table data and non-color status
      cues? [Clarity, FR-016]
- [x] CHK012 Are offline first-load boundaries, arbitrary route/query fallback, install capability
      fallback, and status announcements specified? [Coverage, FR-025-FR-029]
- [x] CHK013 Are update checks, throttling, dirty-state resolution, explicit activation, build
      identity, and old-cache cleanup measurable? [Measurability, SC-008]
- [x] CHK014 Do manifest/icon requirements distinguish standard, maskable, Apple, base-path, theme,
      and zoom-safe metadata? [Completeness, UI/PWA Contract]

## Validation and Release Requirements

- [x] CHK015 Are unit, integration, multi-browser, mobile, accessibility, privacy, offline-outage,
      and two-build update gates all required? [Completeness, Research R11]
- [x] CHK016 Are performance, bundle, data-volume, file-size, and browser-support limits measurable?
      [Measurability, Plan Technical Context]
- [x] CHK017 Does the deployment contract identify the Pages base path while keeping runtime
      hosting-neutral? [Consistency, Research R13]
- [x] CHK018 Are version source, commit identity, schema/format/cache independence, release tag, and
      deployed-version agreement specified? [Clarity, FR-030 and SC-012]
- [x] CHK019 Are pinned reusable workflow, central config, Renovate, release, conventional-title,
      and squash-merge expectations documented? [Completeness, Research R12]
- [x] CHK020 Are out-of-scope services and features explicit enough to prevent telemetry, sync, bank
      integration, FX, or server creep? [Boundary, Spec Assumptions]

## Notes

- Reviewer evaluation occurs before `/speckit-tasks`.
- Leave an item unchecked if its cited requirement or contract needs correction.
- Reviewed 2026-09-03: 20/20 requirements-quality criteria are satisfied.
